address.docs:
**int**: The Modbus server address the component answers on. Defaults to `2`, which is the address the motor's bus controller expects the UAP1 module on. You should not need to change this.

*See also: [Hörmann Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/hoermann_hcp#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Hörmann Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/hoermann_hcp#configuration-variables)*

modbus_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [Modbus](https://esphome.io/components/modbus/) hub.

*See also: [Hörmann Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/hoermann_hcp#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval at which the connection to the bus controller is checked and state changes are published. Raising it delays every door state update by the same amount. Defaults to `500ms`.

*See also: [Hörmann Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/hoermann_hcp#configuration-variables)*

hoermann_hcp_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the `hoermann_hcp` hub. Only required if you have more than one hub.

*See also: [Hörmann Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/hoermann_hcp#configuration-variables)*

is_connected.docs:
`true` while the motor's bus controller is polling the emulated UAP1 module. Turns `false` about two seconds after the motor stops responding, for example after the bus power is cut. Defaults to the `connectivity` device class and the `diagnostic` entity category, so the entity appears under the device's diagnostics rather than on its main card.

*See also: [Hörmann Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/hoermann_hcp#configuration-variables)*
